parameters.query: SELECT id, email, external_id, first_name, last_name, company, lead_status, updated_at FROM contacts WHERE updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND source != 'hubspot'

INSERT INTO contacts (email, first_name, last_name, company, phone, job_title, external_id, source, lead_status) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.first_name }}', '{{ $json.last_name }}', '{{ $json.company }}', '{{ $json.phone }}', '{{ $json.job_title }}', '{{ $json.external_id }}', 'hubspot', '{{ $json.lead_status }}') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name, company = EXCLUDED.company, phone = EXCLUDED.phone, job_title = EXCLUDED.job_title, external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id, lead_status = EXCLUDED.lead_status, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING *
